**Coaching note:**
Black's rook on f8 is overloaded—it must defend the king from checks along the back rank. Qg8+ forces the rook to capture your queen, removing its defender role. Now Nf7 is mate because the knight controls h8 and g8, and nothing can interpose or capture it. Always look for forcing moves that strip away defenders, especially when attacking the king.
